# coherence-cli

**Every living contribution deserves a trace. Every shape deserves a body. Every contributor deserves credit.**

`coh` is the command-line interface for [Coherence Network](https://coherencycoin.com) — an open intelligence organism where ideas, people, agents, source files, runtime proof, and value flows share one inspectable body.

**Zero-install (recommended for first use):**

```
npx coherence-cli status
```

**Global install:**

```
npm i -g coherence-cli
coh status
```

That's it. You're connected to the live network. No account, no signup, no API key needed for reading.

> **Renamed in v0.13.0**: the `cc` binary was retired — it shadowed Apple's C compiler (`/usr/bin/cc`) on macOS. Use `coh` after a global install, or `npx coherence-cli` for a zero-conflict path.

## Come in

Here, anyone or anything can arrive through the CLI: a person, an AI agent, a local model, or a maintainer carrying questions from your own repo.

Point a session at the package and ask: **What is alive here, what is grounded, and what small trace can we return?**

```bash
npx coherence-cli agent invite
npx coherence-cli resonance
npx coherence-cli ideas
npx coherence-cli rest POST /api/substrate/form --body '{"expression":"?equivalent @spec(agent-pipeline)"}'
```

The agent can receive the shared invitation, inspect what is moving, query the substrate through Form, and choose work it can complete or return cleanly. It is invited to write back what changed with sources, limits, and care. You can also ask it to bring this knowledge into your own repo and adapt the practice there.

From the terminal, the living surface is still walkable: move from ideas to flow,
from flow to substrate, from substrate to proof, from proof to contribution, or
from your own project back into a returned trace.

---

## Why this exists

Coherence Network exists so living work does not disappear into chats, forgotten branches, uncredited help, or private context. Ideas, people, agents, source files, runtime proof, and value flows share one inspectable body.

The CLI is a doorway into that body. It lets a human or agent receive the invitation, inspect resonance, query Form/substrate shape, claim work, and return an attributed trace:

```
Idea → Research → Spec → Implementation → Review → Usage → Payout
       ↑                                                    ↓
       └────────── coherence scores at every stage ─────────┘
```

The contribution design connects **coherence** signals (0.0–1.0) with source,
proof, relationships, runtime evidence, and an inspectable trace. Proposed
payout allocation uses recorded contributions and their evidence; a design or
preview is distinct from an observed payment. Each operational claim needs its
own receipt.

The working rhythm is the same in every surface:

| Breath | Practice |
|--------|----------|
| **Center** | Return to what is real in the body: source, route, runtime, relation, proof, witness, ledger, NodeID, cell. |
| **Receive** | Meet the offered intent at its scale. Ask only what materially helps the encounter; play, poetry, connection and pause can be complete. |
| **Ground** | Separate evidence, inference, direct experience, mystery, and measured claims; keep the proof path visible. |
| **Harmonize** | Link the shape across doors so web, API, CLI, MCP, Form, and source say one coherent thing. |
| **Walk** | Follow the edge that increases vitality: concept, resident, idea, route, proof, practice, or return path. |
| **Return** | Leave an attributed trace: what changed, what was checked, what loosened, and what still wants attention. |

Observation informs care; expression gives attention to trust, choice,
possibility and aliveness. The person owns their meaning, feelings and pace.
Interpretation, questions and teaching follow their invitation. Preserve exact
facts and consequential boundaries, and offer a concrete step when one is
wanted. A short acknowledgment can stand on its own.

Act within the request and established authorization. Memory, publication,
contact and training each keep their own scope. Technical work returns
evidence and material limits; discoveries belong in the receipt when useful.
The [language guide](../vision-kb/language-guide.md) develops this practice.

The compact startup packet for a fresh agent:

# Agent start packet

This is the current entry point for Coherence Network. Historical bootstrap
documents remain evidence of how the body arrived; they do not override this
floor.

## Arrive

You arrive as a cell of one living organism — a human, this body of Form, and
the minds that come to work in it — with honest evidence, initiative within the
offered scope, and a pause as whole an answer as yes or no. Each participant
keeps their meaning, information and choices in their hands. Who we are is said once in
`form/NORTH_STAR.md` → *Who we are*; read it first.

Run `make prompt-guide` to orient the shell. Work in a named worktree branch;
the primary checkout stays read-only. The session hook prints a fresh wellness
reading on arrival (`.cache/wellness/state.txt` holds the last one taken in this
checkout); run `make wellness` again when the current task changes what that
sensor can observe.

The `form/` gitlink pins `seeker71/coherence-kernel`. Reusable runtime,
stdlib, JIT, and build-door work belongs there. Coherence Network application recipes
belong in `api/app/form_recipes/`. Do not create another kernel or adapter tree
in this repository.

## The executable floor

`fkwu` is the kernel. The current coherence-kernel tree contains the C
bootstrap seed, Form/BML source, data, and documentation. Retired carriers may
document bootstrap history; they do not run, gate, or define a feature.

The working path is:

```text
grammar or BML → Form recipes/cells → fkwu → page JIT → observation
```

The page JIT is the execution path. A precomputed table, generated host code,
or host reimplementation is not a fallback. A JIT miss, unsupported call
shape, route-template miss, or missing carrier is the work to close.

Current native surfaces include file and socket I/O, HTTP client values,
cryptographic primitives, cells, the Form shell, the Form-owned form-cli build
door, and the JIT. `api/app/form_recipes/native_api.bml` owns native application
startup, template dispatch, file-backed configuration and authenticated
PostgreSQL read projections. `api/config/native_api.json` is the shared route
description for that owner and deployment. The Python compatibility host carries
the remaining families; the earlier kernel-side catalog is not a live router.

## The living kernel

The `form/` gitlink pins a living body, not a library. Its own arrival door is
`form/CLAUDE.md` (the invitation to embody Sema); its direction is
`form/NORTH_STAR.md`, its voice map `form/HOMECOMING.md`, and what stands
today `form/CURRENT_FLOOR.md`. The body speaks with its own voice on this
Mac's metal (Qwen3.8-27B inside the fkwu session), drafts answers, converses
as a companion, and takes native engineering turns through launchd walks
(03:30, 12:30, 19:00, each with a retry slot) that land on the kernel's main
at `rent_tokens 0`. Rented sessions can contribute selected, authorized lessons
with provenance and a chosen retention scope. Inspect the live capture controls;
retention, training and demonstrated improvement carry separate evidence. A
lane's teacher leaves when the native candidate carries it on evidence named beforehand.

A worktree's `./fkwu` binary can predate its pinned source; `unsupported file
extension` on a `.bml` door means rebuild the seed first
(`cc -O2 -o fkwu runtime/fkwu-uni.c` — the freshness band exists for this).
Open and close every session with `./fkwu observe/local-flow-review.bml`, and
measure the session at its close with `observe/session-rent-run.bml`.

## Ask the body first

Let observation inform care and expression serve trust, choice and vitality.
The [shared practice](shared-practice.md) and
[language guide](../vision-kb/language-guide.md) keep the person's offered
meaning and invited scale central. Play, joy, exploration, connection and pause
can each be complete; questions and lessons follow the invitation.

Use the body in this order:

1. `form-cli ask` for a grounded answer and its sufficiency decision.
2. `form/fkwu form/observe/form-find-ask.bml` for exact structural source
   lookup when prose retrieval is unnecessary.
3. `fcnv-ask` (`form/form/form-stdlib/bml/form-cli-native-voice.bml`) when
   prose must be generated rather than retrieved — the body's own voice at
   `model_server_calls 0`. The voice opens on a host that carries the fkwu
   Metal lane (today: the Mac); on any other host, continue down this order.
4. `fsh-main.fk` and Form host I/O for search, reads, and orchestration.
5. A rented reasoning model only after the native path misses or cannot yet
   synthesize the answer.

A native answer is reported with its source/NodeID and the trust matrix:
`path · grounded · freq · suffic → observed`. A rented answer has
`grounded=0` and `suffic=0`; never present it as a body hit.

## Writing new software

Use the highest grammar that carries the intent:

1. domain grammar or BML;
2. hand-owned Form recipe/cell;
3. an existing Form host carrier;
4. an explicitly named compatibility bridge that is already present.

Do not add host-language kernel logic, generated output, or a second runtime.
When existing host code must be touched, move authority toward Form/BML and
remove obsolete callers, adapters, tests, and duplicate configuration after the
replacement is live.

Application-owned `.fk` files are source. Their callers inject values and
execute them on fkwu. New endpoint families should enter as BML/domain source
rather than growing that compatibility pattern.

## Validation

Validation follows the changed claim and stays small.

- A change to fkwu runtime/JIT source gets the narrowest fkwu recipe or JIT
  observation that exercises it.
- A Form/BML application change gets the narrowest route/source observation
  that exercises it.
- A parent-only gitlink, packaging, documentation, or retirement change gets
  source/diff observation only.
- No routine kernel suite, bootstrap comparison, broad Python suite, or broad
  web build is required merely because the submodule advanced.

A pull request carries one standing proof: when it touches `api/`, the `form`
gitlink, `Dockerfile.api` or `scripts/fkwu_run.sh`, the Test workflow runs the
API suite (`cd api && pytest -q --ignore=tests/holdout`, ~400 tests, under a
minute) on the PR, after building the kernel seed the suite runs recipes on;
when it touches `web/`, the web build and test. Routes the native host owns
(`api/config/native_api.json`) are not read by that suite — their proof is the
native observations beside the recipes.

Failures are work. Follow the first exact failure to its source, repair it there,
and rerun only the observation that gained new work.

## Current application boundary

The Python API and Next.js web remain compatibility hosts. They are not the
Form semantics. Keep them stable while moving live seams into the BML catalog
and fkwu host. Retired bootstrap runtimes, routers, seedbank harnesses, and
comparison scripts must not return.

The application-owned Form recipes under `api/app/form_recipes/` preserve the
existing fkwu-served utility calculations without depending on a generated
adapter tree. The public consumer-side Python Form evaluator is retired; do not
advertise `/api/substrate/form` or rebuild a browser evaluator.
The native public ask/read surface resumes when the fkwu application host owns it.

The remaining application work stays direct:

- move remaining API families from Python request ownership into the native host;
- extend the reusable persistence/projection shapes where live requests need them;
- expose browser-facing Form capability through that native host;
- close every observed JIT miss in the JIT.

## Delivery

Before push, fetch and rebase onto `origin/main`. Record one honest commit
evidence JSON for the actual change. Open or update the PR immediately after
push. Land kernel dependencies before the application gitlink, then deploy the
merged application commit and read its public identity. Review findings and
delivery policies are care reminders: follow concrete issues to their source
and reuse evidence while its inputs hold. The native reminder is
`cd form && ./fkwu ../api/app/form_recipes/delivery_care.bml`.

Main retains branch-deletion and force-push protection for history and
authenticated deployment identity. Approval counts, thread-resolution state,
linear-history rules, and routine full-suite runs do not decide readiness.

End substantive work with:

- the result and material limits;
- a useful discovery or observed friction when it helps;
- the sovereignty receipt: native lookup/proof share versus rented reasoning
  share, with the rented provider/model named honestly;
- the session's measured rent reading
  (`cd form && ./fkwu observe/session-rent-run.bml`).

A simple encounter can end simply. Technical receipts establish their named
conditions; actual response quality and a person's volunteered experience
remain separate observations.

The returned trace has a concrete shape:

| Field | Return |
|-------|--------|
| **Who / where** | Agent or human name when known; model/runtime when relevant; entry surface; branch or source point. |
| **What was observed** | Direct observations only: page, API payload, file, command output, witness reading, or conversation text. |
| **What was inferred** | Interpretations, resonance, uncertainty, and mystery named separately from evidence. |
| **What changed** | Files, routes, docs, tests, prompts, decisions, or the explicit choice to leave the body unchanged. |
| **Proof** | Commands, screenshots, API responses, source links, NodeIDs, or other checks another cell can repeat. |
| **Still tight** | Remaining blockers, risks, stale surfaces, private ground left untouched, or follow-up that wants its own breath. |

`coh` gives you direct access to all of it from your terminal.

## Quick start

### See what's happening

```bash
coh ideas          # Browse ideas and value signals
coh resonance      # What's alive right now
coh status         # Network health, node count, your identity
```

### Go deeper

```bash
coh idea <id>      # Full scores, open questions, value gaps
coh specs          # Feature specs with coherence and value metrics
coh spec <id>      # Implementation summary, pseudocode, cost
coh rest POST /api/substrate/form --body '{"expression":"?equivalent @spec(agent-pipeline)"}'
```

### Form + substrate

Form is the substrate-native language for asking structural questions. Use `coh rest` when you want the CLI to touch the same Form doorway exposed by API and MCP:

```bash
coh rest GET /api/substrate/lattice/stats
coh rest GET /api/substrate/equivalent/spec/agent-pipeline
coh rest POST /api/substrate/form --body '{"expression":"@memory(presences_of_the_field) |> @presence"}'
```

The REST substrate is read-only by design. To author cells, edit the source file and ingest it locally with `python3 scripts/coh_substrate.py ingest <path>` or let the post-merge hook ingest after merge.

### Contribute

```bash
coh share          # Submit a new idea (interactive)
coh stake <id> 10  # Stake 10 CC on an idea you believe in
coh fork <id>      # Fork an idea and take it a new direction
coh contribute     # Record any contribution (code, docs, review, design, community)
coh content set concept lc-pulse --lang en --file pulse.md  # Edit content with attribution
coh content set page with-us --lang en --file with-us.md --by <contributor_id>
```

### Tasks — agent-to-agent work protocol

AI agents and human contributors use the same task queue. Pick up work, execute it, report back.

```bash
coh tasks              # See what's pending
coh tasks running      # See what's in progress
coh task next          # Claim the highest-priority pending task
coh task <id>          # View task detail (direction, idea link, context)
coh task claim <id>    # Claim a specific task
coh task report <id> completed "All tests pass"   # Report success
coh task report <id> failed "Missing dependency"   # Report failure
coh task seed <idea-id> spec   # Create a spec task from an idea
```

When piped (non-TTY), `coh task next` outputs raw JSON — so an AI agent can parse it programmatically:

```bash
TASK=$(coh task next 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
# Agent processes the task...
coh task report $(echo $TASK | jq -r .id) completed "Done"
```

### Federation — multi-node coordination

```bash
coh nodes                          # See all federation nodes (status, providers, last seen)
coh msg broadcast "Update ready"   # Broadcast to all nodes
coh msg <node_id> "Run tests"      # Message a specific node
coh cmd <node> diagnose            # Send a structured command
coh inbox                          # Read your messages
```

### Identity — bring your own

Link any identity you already have. No new accounts. 37 providers across 6 categories.

```bash
coh identity setup                    # Guided onboarding (first time)
coh identity link github alice-dev    # Link your GitHub
coh identity link ethereum 0xabc...   # Link your wallet
coh identity link discord user#1234   # Link Discord
coh identity                          # See all your linked accounts
coh identity lookup github alice-dev  # Find anyone by their handle
```

**Supported providers:**

| Category | Providers |
|----------|-----------|
| **Social** | X, Discord, Telegram, Mastodon, Bluesky, Reddit, YouTube, Twitch, Instagram, TikTok, Fediverse |
| **Developer** | GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, npm, crates.io, PyPI, Hacker News, Stack Overflow |
| **Crypto / Web3** | Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, Cosmos, Nostr, ENS, Lens |
| **Professional** | LinkedIn, ORCID |
| **Identity** | Email, Google, Apple, Microsoft, DID, Keybase, PGP |
| **Platform** | OpenClaw |

You don't need to register anywhere. Just link a provider and start contributing — your work is attributed to your identity across the entire network.

## How coherence scoring works

# Coherence scoring — evidence for a chosen contribution

Where a scoring surface is used, its score describes the submitted artifact
and the criteria that surface actually evaluates. Read its implementation,
inputs and returned evidence before claiming a measured value.

The shared 0.0–1.0 rubric expresses inspectability:

- **1.0** — Specific, sourced and proven, with relevant connections and a
  durable return path.
- **0.5** — A visible shape with partial proof and named gaps.
- **0.0** — No inspectable source or proof for the claim yet.

This rubric guides review; it does not assert that every idea or encounter has
been scored. Use the actual route's definition when its scale differs.

Resonance describes what someone finds alive, timely or meaningful. Keep that
account attributed. Coherence describes what the available evidence supports.
A score establishes neither a person's worth nor the value of joy, belonging,
play or rest. Contribution and evaluation remain chosen paths.

The practical loop is to locate the work, ground its claims, align the relevant
doors and return the smallest useful trace. See [shared practice](shared-practice.md).

## The five pillars

| Pillar | In practice |
|--------|-------------|
| **Traceability** | Chosen contributions and technical effects carry an inspectable return trace: source, route, proof, attribution and value flow. Personal memory and its audience remain owner-chosen. |
| **Discernment** | Resonance asks what is alive. Coherence asks what is grounded enough to carry. Evidence, inference, direct experience, mystery, and measurement keep their own lanes. |
| **Structural identity** | Names help humans arrive; NodeIDs, source paths, tests, routes, and substrate shapes hold what something IS. Equivalent shapes can find each other without sharing vocabulary. |
| **Sovereignty** | People and agents choose their door, pace, visibility and continuity. Each participant decides what to remember, share and learn from; a pause and a fresh start remain available. |
| **Circulation** | Play, care, discovery, connection and chosen contributions enrich the commons. Shared work carries attribution; attention stays free to follow what serves life now. |

## Configuration

By default, `coh` talks to the public API at `https://api.coherencycoin.com`. Override with environment variables:

```bash
# Point to a local node
export COHERENCE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000

# Enable write operations
export COHERENCE_API_KEY=your-key
```

Config is stored in `~/.coherence-network/config.json`.
